title: The Room above the Shoe Shop
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：agency　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 agency 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 there was one ① travel agency in the town, in a room above a shoe shop, and the woman in it had never been anywhere and could describe everywhere. My mother said an ② agency is a place that sells a thing it does not own, and my father said that was the definition of a shop, and they did not speak for two days; agency, my mother said later, is only another word for believing somebody.

The ③ news agency photograph of the flood in 1968 had been taken from our street, and my grandmother kept it for thirty-one years and never once said whose house it was. There was ④ a government agency involved by 1972, which sent four letters and one man, and the man stayed an hour and the letters are still in a drawer; an agency, my grandmother said, is what a thing becomes when nobody will take it.

We got the money ⑤ through the agency of the woman above the shoe shop, who filled in a form nobody else could read and would not take anything for it. My father said ⑥ agency of that kind is the only kind worth having, and my mother said it was the same as the other kind and he said it was not, and that was the end of it.

The ⑦ agency closed in 1979 and the woman went to work in the shoe shop, which she said was the same job without the stamps. There was ⑧ no agency in the town after that, and by 1984 you had to go nine miles for a stamp, and my grandmother said every agency is a door with a bell on it.

The ⑨ agency I would put in the photograph, if I were taking it, is not the water but the room above the shoe shop and the form nobody could read. An ⑩ agency, my father said in 1990, is only ever one person who knows how a form works, and when that person goes the agency goes with them; the agency was the woman.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 代理机构；中介
B. n. 代办处；服务点
C. n. 作用；力量（through the agency of）
D. n. 代理（业务）；中介作用
E. 固定搭配：travel agency 旅行社
F. 固定搭配：news agency 通讯社
G. 固定搭配：through / by the agency of ... 通过……的帮助／作用
H. 固定搭配：a government / UN agency 政府／联合国（专门）机构

items.q: one travel agency in the town
an agency is a place that sells
The news agency photograph of the flood
through the agency of the woman
agency of that kind is the only kind
no agency in the town after that
The agency I would put in the photograph
An agency, my father said in 1990

answers.why: travel agency 意为“旅行社”，1971 年镇上只有一家旅行社，开在鞋店楼上的一间屋里。
agency 意为“代理机构、中介”，母亲说中介就是卖自己并不拥有的东西的地方。
news agency 意为“通讯社”，1968 年那张洪水照片是一家通讯社拍的，拍摄点就在我们那条街上。
a government agency 意为“政府机构”，到 1972 年有一个政府机构介入，寄来四封信、派来一个人。
through the agency of ... 意为“通过……的帮助”，我们是通过鞋店楼上那位女士的帮助拿到那笔钱的。
agency 意为“作用、力量”，父亲说只有这样起作用的 agency 才值得有。
agency 意为“代理机构”，那家旅行社 1979 年关了，那位女士转去鞋店工作。
agency 意为“代理（业务）、中介作用”，1979 年之后镇上再没有代理业务，到 1984 年要买邮票得走九英里。
agency 意为“代办处、服务点”，若由我来拍那张照片，我要拍的不是洪水而是鞋店楼上那个代办处。
agency 意为“代理机构”，父亲说所谓代理机构，其实就是某个懂得表格怎么填的人。
